brief:
The Hind Rajab Foundation filed a criminal complaint in the Netherlands against a former US-Israeli soldier accused of involvement in attacks on schools sheltering civilians during the Gaza conflict, Middle East Eye reported. The complaint was lodged while the soldier was visiting the country.

The foundation, named after a Gaza child killed in the conflict, did not disclose the soldier's identity or specify which incidents formed the basis of the allegation. The complaint invokes Dutch jurisdiction to investigate potential war crimes.

title: Dutch prosecutors receive war crimes complaint against US-Israeli former soldier
